resources.string: DutyPe works only because people trust each other. Follow these rules every time. Breaking them gets your account blocked, and serious misuse is reported to the police.
I have read the code of conduct and will follow it
How to behave, stay safe and get paid

string-array.name: guide_partner_before
string-array.item: Accept a job only if you can reach on time. If you can\'t, give it back in the app at once.
Carry the tools listed in the job (tool kit, tester, machine) and wear clean clothes.
Check what the customer keeps ready. Call them from the app if something is missing.
Never go drunk or after taking tobacco / gutka.

string-array.name: guide_partner_at
string-array.item: Greet politely and show your DutyPe partner screen. Leave footwear outside if asked.
Ask for the 4-digit start code only after you reach. Start the work only after entering it.
Tell the price before you start. For extra work or parts, tell the price first and start only after the customer agrees.
Respect women, children and elders. Enter only the rooms needed for the work. No phone photos of the family or house.
Do only the work you are trained for. If it is unsafe or beyond your skill, say so honestly.

string-array.name: guide_partner_safety
string-array.item: Electrical work: switch off the main / MCB first and check with a tester. Use insulated tools and gloves.
Use a steady ladder and ask someone to hold it. Never stand on chairs or buckets.
Gas, chemicals and acids: open windows, wear gloves, keep away from children.
If you feel unsafe at a home, leave and call DutyPe support or 112.

string-array.name: guide_partner_money
string-array.item: Collect only the amount shown in the app (cash or UPI). Never ask for tips, travel charges or extra money.
Spare parts: show the bill and charge the bill price only.
DutyPe takes its small fee from your credits after the job. Keep credits topped up.
Do not ask customers to book you outside the app. It removes your insurance of trust and gets the account blocked.

string-array.name: guide_partner_after
string-array.item: Clean the work area and take your waste with you.
Show the finished work to the customer, then mark the job complete in the app.
If something goes wrong (damage, injury, dispute), tell DutyPe support the same day.

string-array.name: guide_partner_never
string-array.item: Theft, damage on purpose, or taking anything from the house.
Misbehaving with, touching or harassing anyone, especially women and children.
Threats, abuse or violence. Coming drunk.
Overcharging, fake parts bills, or using the customer\'s phone number / address for anything else.
Sending another person in your place or using someone else\'s account.

string-array.name: guide_worker_before
string-array.item: Read the job, pay and timings fully before you apply or accept.
Apply only for work you can really do. Go only if you will reach on time.
If you can\'t come, tell the employer and cancel in the app at once.
DutyPe jobs are free. Never pay anyone to get a job. Report anyone who asks for money.

string-array.name: guide_worker_at
string-array.item: Reach on time, carry an ID card, and be polite.
Follow the employer\'s safe instructions. Ask if something is not clear.
Do not share OTPs, bank PINs or passwords with anyone.
Urgent work is for a short time (a few hours or days). Regular jobs are for weekly or monthly pay.

string-array.name: guide_worker_safety
string-array.item: Meet at the posted shop / office / site. Do not go to a different, lonely place.
For night work or a far place, tell your family where you are going. Women can share live location.
Refuse unsafe work: heights without support, chemicals without gloves, electrical work you are not trained for.
In danger call 112. Women helpline 181. Child helpline 1098. Online fraud 1930.

string-array.name: guide_worker_money
string-array.item: Agree the pay before you start. Urgent work is paid the same day; jobs are paid weekly or monthly as posted.
If you are not paid, report it in the app with the job name. DutyPe warns and blocks employers who don\'t pay.

string-array.name: guide_worker_never
string-array.item: Fake name, photo or documents, or sending someone else in your place.
Theft, damage, fighting, abuse or misbehaviour with anyone.
Coming drunk to work.
Taking advance money and not coming.

string-array.name: guide_employer_posting
string-array.item: Post only real jobs with the true pay, timings and place.
Regular jobs: weekly or monthly pay. Urgent posts: short work paid the same day.
Never take money from workers for a job, training, uniform or ID.
Pay at least the Telangana minimum wage. No child labour: no one below 14, and no one below 18 in risky work.

string-array.name: guide_employer_workers
string-array.item: Treat workers with respect. No abuse, beating or harassment. Keep women workers safe.
Give safe working conditions: drinking water, breaks, safety gear for risky work.
Pay on time as agreed. Do not keep a worker\'s ID card, phone or documents.
Use a worker\'s phone number only for that job.

string-array.name: guide_employer_services
string-array.item: Keep ready what the booking says (broom and mop for house cleaning, ladder, water, power).
An adult should be at home. Give the 4-digit start code only when the partner reaches.
Check the work, then pay the amount in the app (cash or UPI) to the partner.
Problem with the work? Report within 7 days for free re-work. Don\'t pay extra outside the app bill.

string-array.name: guide_employer_never
string-array.item: Fake jobs, collecting money from workers, or posting illegal work.
Not paying agreed wages, or holding back wages to force work.
Abuse, threats, violence or sexual harassment of workers or partners.
Child labour or bonded labour.
Using workers\' phone numbers or photos for spam, loans, or anything other than the job.

string-array.name: guide_help
string-array.item: Emergency: 112 (police, ambulance, fire).
Women helpline: 181. Child helpline: 1098. Cyber fraud: 1930.
Report a person in the app (Report button) or write to dutypein@gmail.com. Keep screenshots and call details.
DutyPe keeps records of jobs, bookings and chats and gives them to the police when the law asks.
